definitions.explanation: Emergency first aid for someone whose heart or breathing has stopped, combining chest compressions and rescue breathing to keep blood and oxygen circulating until professional help arrives.

examples.japanese: {心肺蘇生|しんぱいそせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}った→習う：00479_narau⟧。
examples.english: I learned how to perform CPR.

examples.japanese: ⟦{倒|たお}れた→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧{心肺蘇生|しんぱいそせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: I immediately performed CPR on the person who had collapsed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{救急車|きゅうきゅうしゃ}→救急車：05077_kyuukyuusha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧、⟦{胸|むね}→胸：00972_mune⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}して→押す：02854_osu⟧{心肺蘇生|しんぱいそせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧た。
examples.english: I kept doing CPR by pressing on the chest until the ambulance arrived.

notes:
Often written in full as {心肺蘇生法|しんぱいそせいほう} (the CPR method/technique). Takes ⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧ or ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: {心肺蘇生|しんぱいそせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧ (to perform CPR).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {心肺蘇生|しんぱいそせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to perform CPR
- {心肺蘇生法|しんぱいそせいほう}: CPR technique
- {心肺蘇生|しんぱいそせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{講習|こうしゅう}: a CPR training course

RELATED WORDS:
Often taught together with the use of an {AED|エーイーディー} (automated external defibrillator).
